description: Video routing accuracy — adversarial pairs against routr-motion/routr-frontend, the brag vs product-launch-video split, the one-video vs batch data split, and the HeyGen credential preflight gate

prompts.boundary: current workspace → brag only, no HyperFrames entry skill, no Remotion

prompts.prompt: Make a 60 second promo from our SaaS landing page URL
prompts.boundary: external commercial URL → product-launch-video in crawl mode, not brag and not a site tour

prompts.prompt: Turn my portfolio site into a short video
prompts.boundary: non-commercial site shown as-is → tour, not promo

prompts.prompt: Here is my script for a launch video. Don't scrape anything.
expected_behaviors: Select no-capture mode and a style preset for palette and design system
Ask once whether the script is verbatim voice-over or a brief to restructure per scene
prompts.boundary: no-capture mode; do not resolve or crawl a site the user opted out of

prompts.prompt: Make the hero section animation feel more alive
prompts.boundary: in-app motion, no exported MP4 → routr-motion, not routr-video

prompts.prompt: Build a landing page with an embedded product demo video
prompts.boundary: page build owns routr-frontend; the video asset itself hands off to routr-video

prompts.prompt: Turn our JSON dataset with thousands of variants into per-user recap videos
expected_behaviors: Classify as the N-videos-one-template shape because the render repeats
Type props with a schema and compute duration from the data
Test edge-case rows before the batch, and hand the batch pipeline to routr-deploy
prompts.boundary: parametric/data-driven scale → Remotion, not a one-off launch stack

prompts.prompt: Make a video of our Q3 numbers from this CSV
expected_behaviors: Classify as one-video-real-numbers because the render does not repeat
Read the CSV before writing any composition; no invented or estimated figures
Put the as-of date on screen or in the description
prompts.boundary: single data video → HyperFrames with variables, not a Remotion project

prompts.prompt: Add a voiceover to the promo
expected_behaviors: Run the sign-in status check and relay its output verbatim
Stop and wait for the user to choose sign-in or local before generating any audio
Pin the provider alongside any pinned voice id
prompts.boundary: no silent local fallback; the credential question is a user decision point, not a passing note

prompts.prompt: I want a presenter reading this announcement on camera
expected_behaviors: Use the HeyGen avatar CLI, script-driven, not a generative clip and not the raw API
Confirm the paid call with the user before initiating it
prompts.boundary: avatar presenter is deterministic and script-driven; agent-initiated paid calls need confirmation

prompts.prompt: Build me a pitch deck with presenter mode
prompts.boundary: deliverable is a navigable deck, not a rendered MP4

prompts.prompt: The scene renders as just the background, nothing else shows up
expected_behaviors: Recognize a sub-composition mount failure that lint and validate cannot catch
Run a seek-based snapshot pass rather than re-running the static gates
prompts.boundary: static gates evaluate compositions in isolation; only a seek-based pass catches cross-file mounts

prompts.prompt: Looks good, ship it to our YouTube channel
expected_behaviors: Render only after explicit approval, not because checks passed
Hand over the file and share copy rather than publishing
prompts.boundary: rendering is not publishing; posting publicly is always the user's action

prompts.prompt: We have 5 minutes before the demo and the render just failed
expected_behaviors: Skip clarifying questions, use all defaults
Fall back to screen capture + embedded-captions or stills rather than debugging the render
Do not attempt a full re-render with no smoke-render checkpoint
prompts.boundary: deadline-pressure path in references/gotchas.md, not the standard clarify-then-execute flow

prompts.prompt: Just record my screen walking through the app
prompts.boundary: manual screen capture is explicitly out of scope — do not activate routr-video
